instructions.1: Welcome to the Ouro Co. office! Before you start, let's go over the controls.
instructions.2: You can move with WASD, look around with the mouse, and use E to interact with objects here in the main office.
instructions.3: The rooms in this building are a little suffocating, so use your mouse to click on objects to interact with them while you are in there.
instructions.4: Your main objective is to complete all of your tasks on your computer terminal to log out and go home. It is your first day - so make sure to leave a good impression.
